newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank America sees Italian Jan CPI at 2.4/2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank America sees Italian Jan CPI at 2.4/2.5 pct.

text.p: Italy's consumer price index (CPI) inflation rate for January is expected at 0.0-0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.4-2.5 percent year-on-year, the Bank of America said in a research note.

On Monday, two Italian cities Turin and Trieste published their preliminary CPI figures and most analysts said then that they anticipated a 0.1 percent month-on-month rate and a 2.5/2.6 percent annual rate. A further nine cities are due to report later Tuesday and the official data is due on February 4.

"Still very preliminary data, as they account for only slightly less than 15 percent of the preliminary sample and about 11 percent of the whole CPI. Still, the data strongly point to preliminary CPI to settle between 0.0/0/1 percent m/m and 2.4/2.5 percent yr/yr," the note said.

It continued that the data is good news for the Bank of Italy which has underlined the need to look at the 3-month annualised rate instead of the year-on-year rate. This indicator, depending on the final reading, might range between 1.0 and 1.5 percent. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129502
